title: Render Google sign-in
responsibility: Load the fixed Google Identity script and render its popup sign-in button.

inputs.name: googleButton.element
inputs.description: DOM element that will receive the button.

inputs.name: googleButton.options
inputs.description: Client ID, fresh challenge nonce and callback receiving the signed credential.

outputs.name: googleIdentityScript
outputs.description: Fixed Google Identity Services script URL.

outputs.name: googleButton
outputs.description: Promise resolving after initialization and button rendering; inserts the script once per shared loading promise and forwards credentials to the callback without retaining them.
